font_loading_note: Fonts live in the shared /fonts directory at repo root, not inside this skill folder -- other skills (church, sports, etc.) reuse the same family files rather than each bundling copies. Most families ship as single variable-weight files from Google's official repo, not per-weight statics. Load with ImageFont.truetype(path, size) then call font.set_variation_by_name(headline_variation) when headline_variation is not null. Verified working on Pillow 12.1.1. Lato and Poppins ship as separate static weight files -- headline_variation/accent_variation is null for those, load the exact filename directly.
